verdict.rationale: Milvus is documented as open-source and self-hostable (Lite, Standalone, Distributed), and supports vector CRUD and data retrieval through a shared API. A user can therefore keep data on their own infrastructure and read it all back programmatically to migrate away. However, nothing in the pack documents a dedicated export, backup, or dump tool, or any output to open formats such as Parquet, JSON, or CSV. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export/backup tool, explicit open-format export targets, and hands-on evidence of migrating data out.
